style: Original 4:3 food photographs, pale oak, beige linen, warm side light, same white enamel tray with dark blue rim; no text, logos, people or hands
first: Four peeled whole sweet onions and empty roasting tray
stages: Four large peeled sweet onions on the cutting board, each with a small shallow well scooped from its TOP center, about 2 cm across and 3 cm deep, roots and bases intact so the bulbs hold together. A small spoon and knife resting nearby. Small pieces removed from the centers in a separate tiny bowl. No cross-cut rings, no hollowed empty onion shells.

A small ivory bowl containing softened butter mixed with olive oil, sweet red paprika, garlic powder, black pepper and salt. The butter is a thick orange-red seasoning paste, not liquid sauce. A spoon rests in the bowl. The four prepared whole onions with small top wells are visible behind, alongside the same blue-rimmed enamel tray.

The same four peeled whole onions on individual square sheets of aluminum foil, each small top well filled with a modest portion of orange-red paprika garlic butter. A little seasoning paste lightly coats the outsides. Onions upright, each one intact, no extra cheese, no bread crumbs. The same enamel tray nearby.

FOUR neatly sealed individual foil packets holding whole onions, upright in a two-by-two arrangement in the SAME white rectangular enamel roasting tray with thin dark blue rim. Seams closed at the top to hold steam and butter. On pale oak counter beside beige linen. No visible raw onion, no open packets yet.

The same white enamel tray with dark blue rim holding four closed foil onion packets on the center rack of a clean oven. Warm oven light, realistic home oven interior, door open just enough for the photograph. No visible display digits, no other food, no flames. These are baking, not boiling in water.

The same roasting tray on a heatproof trivet, four foil packets opened carefully at the TOP. Inside each is a tender whole roasted onion, translucent creamy layers and glossy paprika butter, tops lightly golden and browned after finishing uncovered in the oven. Gentle steam. A fork rests beside one onion to check softness. No charred black skin, no breading.

Appetizing hero finished food photo: one whole roasted sweet onion on a shallow ivory plate, its tender translucent layers gently opened into a few broad petals, glossy amber-red paprika garlic butter pooling modestly around it, little chopped fresh parsley. Onion should be soft and juicy with some golden edges, NOT fried or breaded, not dark burnt. The same white blue-rimmed enamel tray with other roasted onions and opened foil packets softly blurred behind. Pale oak, beige linen and warm side window light. Recipe cover composition, no hands, no words.
